newsitem.title: USA: Folgers to raise 13 oz can of coffee 15 cts.
newsitem.headline: Folgers to raise 13 oz can of coffee 15 cts.

text.p: Procter and Gamble's Folgers Coffee Co said it will raise the list price on its standard 13-ounce can of coffee by 15 cents due to higher prices of green coffee on the world's futures markets.
The increase, which is to take effect on March 17, brings the new price for a standard can to $2.41, the company said.
"The list price of Folgers coffee generally reflects the price of green coffee sold on the commodity market," Folgers said in a statement.

"After about 10 months of stability, green coffee prices began increasing in January 1997, due to a number of factors including continued limited supplies of Central American coffees, a decrease in size estimates for the next Brazil coffee crop, dock strikes and threatened growers strikes in Colombia, and an announcement by the Association of Coffee Producing Countries of their intention to limit exports," the statement continued.

Folgers also announced it will raise its list price on its 13-ounce can of decaffeinated coffee 10 cents to $3.11, while instant coffee will go up 1.25 cents per ounce to $3.66 per eight-ounce can. "Singles" packet coffee will remain the same.
